resource_scope: gateway PID RSS/CPU; no child RSS aggregation
scope: Synthetic completion with original deadlines and client retries; no model quality or real-provider claim

gateway.toml.text:
startup_hold_secs = 0
listen = "127.0.0.1:55294"
concurrency = 2
cancel_policy = "close"
accounting = "actual"
retry_transient_429 = false
[upstream]
api_base = "http://127.0.0.1:55293/v1"
[upstream.auth]
mode = "none"

[quota.rpm]
kind = "known"
value = 1000000

[quota.tpm]
kind = "known"
value = 1000000000

[[models]]
id = "synthetic"
input_estimator = "cl100k_base"
input_token_overhead = 256
max_output_tokens = 4096

[[roots]]
id = "r0"
endpoints = ["chat/completions", "models"]
models = ["synthetic"]

[[roots]]
id = "r1"
endpoints = ["chat/completions", "models"]
models = ["synthetic"]

[[roots]]
id = "r2"
endpoints = ["chat/completions", "models"]
models = ["synthetic"]

[[roots]]
